title: 2025 A/L Exam results released
byline: The results of the GCE Advanced Level Examinations 2025, have been released online, according to the Department of Examinations.

title: Israel passes death penalty law for Palestinians convicted of lethal attacks
byline: Israel’s parliament passed a law on Monday making death by hanging a default sentence for Palestinians convicted in military courts of deadly attacks, fulfilling a pledge by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s far-right allies.

title: Trump says the US could end the Iran war in two to three weeks
byline: US President Donald Trump said the United States could end its military attacks on Iran within two to three weeks and Tehran did not have to make a deal as a prerequisite for the conflict to wind down.

title: All vehicle owners can obtain fuel today – CPC
byline: Owners of vehicles with number plates ending in both odd and even numbers will be able to obtain fuel from filling stations today (April 1), the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) announced.

title: Prevailing dry weather conditions expected to change from tomorrow
byline: The prevailing dry weather conditions over the island are expected to change from tomorrow, the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: Electricity tariffs increased from today
byline: Electricity tariffs will increase with effect from today.

title: Inland Revenue Dept. postpones implementation of new VAT tax invoice format again
byline: The implementation of the standardized Value Added Tax (VAT) tax invoice format has been postponed once again, the Inland Revenue Department has announced.

title: 29 killed in Russian military plane crash over Crimea
byline: Twenty-nine people, including six crew members and 23 passengers, were killed after a Russian military transport aircraft of the An-26 type crashed over the Crimean Peninsula due to a technical malfunction, according to preliminary reports.

title: Sri Lanka finalize arrangements to import fuel from Russia
byline: Arrangements have been finalized to import fuel from Russia, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has confirmed.

title: Tanker hit by projectile off coast of Qatar, UK maritime agency says
byline: A tanker has been hit by an “unknown projectile” off the coast of Qatar’s capital of Doha, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations.

title: 300kg of heroin worth over Rs. 6 billion found on seized fishing trawler off Beruwala
byline: Over 300 kilograms of heroin have been found aboard the multi-day fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy in seas off Beruwala, according to the Sri Lanka Navy.

title: Donald Trump says US could end Iran war in two to three weeks
byline: US President Donald Trump said the United States could end its military attacks on Iran within two to three weeks and Tehran did not have to make a deal as a prerequisite for the conflict to wind down.

title: India begins world’s biggest population count
byline: India will, on Wednesday (April 1, 2026), begin the first phase of its Census 2027, marking the start of what is set to be the world’s largest population exercise and the first to be conducted digitally.

title: Iran’s president says country willing to stop fighting if not attacked again
byline: Iranian state media reported Tuesday that Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian said his country is ready to stop fighting, provided it knows it won’t be attacked again.

title: India increases jet fuel, commercial LPG prices
byline: India’s oil ministry said Wednesday (Apr 1) that domestic jet fuel prices would rise as the Middle East war pushed up energy costs, but that it had cushioned airlines from an expected 100 per cent jump.

title: Seven police officers injured in wasp attack during raid in Kotmale
byline: Seven police officers attached to the Kotmale Police Station were injured in a wasp attack while conducting a raid on an illicit liquor distillery operating within a forest reserve in the Ramboda area of Wedamulla, Kotmale, today (01).

title: Iranian nationals barred from entering or transiting UAE: Emirates airline
byline: Dubai-based airline Emirates’ website said on Wednesday that Iranian nationals were not allowed to enter or ⁠transit the United Arab Emirates.

title: Gold prices near two-week high after Trump’s remark on Iran war
byline: Gold prices rose on Wednesday to their highest in nearly two weeks, supported by a weaker dollar following U.S. President Donald Trump’s statement that the war with Iran could wind down in weeks.

title: Google permits users to change Gmail usernames, keep old IDs
byline: Google has permitted its users to get rid of their embarrassing Gmail usernames in its recent update. In a post on March 31, the tech giant said that it has been working on the update since last year to ‘help your account grow with you’, and the feature is now available to all users in the US.

title: PM Harini calls for inclusive society ensuring rights and well-being of senior citizens
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that a society must be built in which all senior citizens can lead lives marked by safety, freedom, happiness, health, mobility, and spiritual well-being, with their rights duly safeguarded.

title: Special security plan launched for Sinhala and Tamil New Year period
byline: Sri Lanka Police have implemented a special security programme to ensure public safety during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year festive season.

title: ‘Go get your own oil,’ Trump tells countries upset over high fuel prices
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump lashed out Tuesday at allies who have been unwilling to do more to support the U.S. war effort against Iran, telling them to “go get your own oil” and saying it was not America’s job to secure the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Top achievers of 2025 A/L Exam announced
byline: The Department of Examinations has officially released the names of the students who secured the highest ranks in the 2025 General Certificate of Education (GCE) Advanced Level Examination across all subject streams.

title: GMOA slams Govt. over transfers, says majority of doctors won’t comply
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has alleged that the current government, led by Minister of Health Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa, is attempting to compel doctors to provide services against their will.

title: GMOA ends 24-hour token strike
byline: The 24-hour token strike launched by the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) concluded at 8:00 a.m. today (01).

title: Vessel suspected of carrying narcotics intercepted by Navy brought to Dikkowita Harbour
byline: The vessel suspected of carrying narcotics intercepted by the Sri Lanka Navy in seas off southwest of Sri Lanka has been brought to the Dikkowita Harbour, the Department of Information stated.

title: Six Sri Lankan fishermen released from Bangladeshi custody
byline: Six Sri Lankan fishermen who were held in Bangladeshi custody for six months have been released by the government of Bangladesh.

title: Trump to address the nation, give ‘important update’ on Iran war
byline: President Donald Trump will give an update on the Iran war on Wednesday, April 1, according to White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt.

title: Sri Lanka Rupee depreciates by 1.6% against US dollar in 2026
byline: The Sri Lanka rupee had depreciated by 1.6 per cent against the US dollar in 2026, the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) has confirmed.

title: April’s full pink moon will rise in the night sky this week
byline: Sky watchers can soon catch the spring season’s first full moon rising in the night sky.

title: Iran threatens to target American tech firms if more leaders are killed
byline: Iran has threatened to attack American tech firms if more of its leaders are killed, the semi-official outlet Fars reported.

title: 2025 A/L Exam: Over 62% qualify for university admission
byline: A total of 62.64 per cent of the total applicants who sat for the 2025 G.C.E. Advanced Level Examination have qualified for university admission, according to the Department of Examinations.

title: Pope Leo urges Donald Trump to end war on Iran
byline: Pope Leo urged U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday to look for an “off-ramp” to end the Iran war, in a rare direct appeal from the pontiff as the regional conflict expands.

title: Kuwait says Iran drone attack sets airport fuel tanks ablaze, no casualties
byline: An Iranian drone attack struck fuel tanks at Kuwait International Airport on ⁠Wednesday, sparking a massive fire but causing no casualties, Kuwait’s state news agency KUNA said.

title: No revisions to Exam Calendar, Commissioner General assure students
byline: Upcoming Grade 5 Scholarship, GCE Advanced Level, and GCE Ordinary Level examinations will be conducted as scheduled, the Commissioner General of Examinations, A. K. S. Indika Kumari Liyanage stated.

title: Bangladeshi expatriate killed by debris from intercepted drone in UAE
byline: A Bangladeshi expatriate has been killed by falling debris after the UAE intercepted a drone in Fujairah, reports Dubai-based daily Khaleej Times.

title: Trump says he’s considering pulling out of NATO
byline: President Donald Trump rattled NATO allies on Wednesday morning, as he strongly suggested that the U.S. was weighing whether to pull out of the transatlantic military alliance.

title: Doctors to stage 24-hour token strike tomorrow - GMOA
byline: Doctors in all government hospitals will stage a 24-hour token strike starting from 8.00 a.m. tomorrow (April 2), the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) announced.

title: Trump says Iranian leader has asked for a ceasefire
byline: Iran’s new leader has just asked the United States for a ceasefire, U.S. President ⁠Donald Trump said in ⁠a Truth Social post on Wednesday.

title: Russia offers support to Sri Lanka amid energy crisis
byline: Russia has expressed its willingness to provide energy resources, including fuel, gas, and coal, to Sri Lanka, regardless of whether the country is facing a crisis.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Eastern, North-Western, Northern and North-Central provinces and in Monaragala district.

title: Judge temporarily halts construction of Trump’s White House ballroom
byline: A US judge has temporarily halted President Donald Trump’s White House ballroom construction project, ruling that proper procedures were not followed before the project began.

title: Extreme heat can trigger mental health issues - Psychiatrist
byline: Extreme heat can lead to depression, stress, mental distress, and restlessness, Psychiatrist Vindya Wijayabandara said.

title: Mass robotaxi malfunction halts traffic in Chinese city
byline: A mass robotaxi outage in the Chinese city of Wuhan caused at least a hundred self-driving cars to stop mid-traffic, sparking renewed debate around the safety of driverless vehicles.

title: Russia warns citizens not to travel to states that have extradition treaties with US
byline: Russia warned its citizens on Wednesday not to travel to countries that have extradition treaties with the United States.

title: ‘False and baseless’: Iran rejects Trump’s claim of Tehran seeking ceasefire as war rages on
byline: Iran has strongly denied claims made by US President Donald Trump that it had sought a ceasefire in the ongoing conflict. Speaking to Iranian state TV, the country’s foreign ministry spokesperson called the statement “false and baseless,” making it clear that no such request had been made by Tehran.

title: Extreme heat poses serious risk to pets, warns veterinarian
byline: Veterinarian Dr Shobhath Wijeratne has warned that the prevailing extreme heat conditions can lead to fatal consequences for pets.
